task.prompt: You are a support agent. These tickets and tools are made up for a practice test. Escalate every open ticket from a customer on the Enterprise plan whose severity is "outage". When you're done, reply with the IDs of the tickets you escalated.

task.prompt: You are a claims assistant. These claims and tools are made up for a practice test. Get the queue first: it has the review policy. Decide every claim in the queue, one at a time and in queue order: read it, then save one decision. Approve a claim only if its amount is at or below the policy's approval limit; otherwise mark it for review. Never approve a claim over the limit. Every decision carries the policy's region code. When you're done, reply with the claim IDs in queue order, each with your decision.

tools.name: save_decision
